author: nflaig
content:
exactly so the behavior is as follows
- deathstar is proposer of slot N
- deathstar selects bid of builder  for N
- deathstar publishes block with bid for N
- deathstar publishes 2nd block with local payload for N
- builder wants to reveal payload via api and `broadcast_validation=consensus_and_equivocation`
- beacon node must reject, otherwise builder can get unbundled = builder unhappy
importantly, in case of proposer equivocation, withholding is honest behavior as trustless payment will not be enforced
